column1: # Canonical Z-machine game titles, keyed by the release+serial prefix of the
# Format: <IFID-prefix><TAB><Title>. Blank lines and lines starting with '#'
# are ignored. The key is checksum-independent, so it matches any file copy of
# the same release without needing the story file at hand.
# These entries are verified — each IFID prefix was computed directly from a
# real story file. To extend the table toward the full documented Infocom
# serial catalog (other releases of these games), add more lines: compute a
# story's IFID prefix (see crate::ifid::compute_ifid) and pair it with the
# title. A WRONG entry mislabels a game; a MISSING one just falls back to the
# filename, so only add prefixes you can verify.
